Camera Orientation.description: The world space unit vector for the camera forward direction.

Client Predicted Vehicle.description: The client-predicted vehicle the player is riding. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate the player is in a vehicle.

Client Tick.description: Which simulation frame client is on.

Input Data.description: Bitset of per-tick input flags (jumping, sneaking, gliding, collisions, etc.). Each flag gates additional optional fields below.
Input Data.x-runtime-constraint-description: Verify input data entries are known, unique, and not deprecated

Input Mode.description: The input device the player is using (mouse/keyboard, touch, gamepad, motion controller).

Interact Rotation.description: The rotation the player is looking for interactions.

Item Stack Request.description: Item stack request for this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate a request occurred.

Item Use Transaction.description: Item use transaction for this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate a transaction occurred.

Move Vector.description: The desired local space move direction of the player.

New Interaction Model.description: The interaction model in use (classic, touch, or crosshair).

Play Mode.description: The play mode (normal or one of the reality/VR modes).

Player Block Actions.description: Block actions performed this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate block actions occurred.

items.x-runtime-constraint-description: Verify block actions are one of StartDestroyBlock, AbortDestroyBlock, StopDestroyBlock, CrackBlock, PredictDestroyBlock, or ContinueDestroyBlock

Player Head Rotation.description: Effectively the same as the Y component of Player Rotation.

Player Rotation.description: Orientation of the player at the start of the tick.

Pos Delta.description: Client predicted velocity at the end of the tick.

Position.description: Client predicted position at the end of the tick.

Raw Move Vector.description: Same as move vector but not affected by input permissions.

Vehicle Rotation.description: Rotation of the vehicle the player is in. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate the player is in a vehicle.
